data.exact_reserve_text: In 2016, there has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 0.7m (2015: GBP 0.6m) due primarily to a reduction in claims estimates as uncertainty around catastrophe exposure unwinds. 2014 at 24 months included a reduction in respect of reserves required for Superstorm Sandy. The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a release of GBP 0.4m (2015: GBP 0.3m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: 2014 at 24 months included a reduction in respect of reserves required for Superstorm Sandy (favourable development).

Significant tornado activity in Texas elevated the incurred loss ratio for 2016.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's prior-year reserves (2014 and earlier) showed a small gross adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 0.014m driven by a modest upward adjustment to the 2014 ultimate estimate at 36 months versus 24 months. However, across all underwriting years the report states an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 0.7m in 2016, reflecting favourable claims development as uncertainty around catastrophe exposure unwound (including a reduction in reserves for Superstorm Sandy). The syndicate remains concentrated in US property catastrophe business, so movements are driven by property catastrophe development and commutation/RITC activity.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross figures in the notes). The triangle only contains underwriting years 2014-2016; excluding the two most recent years leaves only 2014 for PYD, producing a small gross strengthening of GBP 0.014m. Narrative and net movement lines elsewhere report net releases (e.g. net release GBP 0.4m and overall surplus GBP 0.7m) - these are net of reinsurance and differ from the gross triangle-derived figure. RITC commutations (2012/2013) are present in the notes and can distort movements; granularity is limited since the report is concentrated in a single class (US property catastrophe) and most balances are held/interacted with Syndicate 2791.
